mechanism_narrative: A sustained 1-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, which boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5% in the next month signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite UNRATE rising above 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDP (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) over the next month signals robust demand growth, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 1000.0 and HOUST rises > 1036.0 in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the simultaneous rise in GDPC1 and HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in the INDPRO supply index below 98.7439 in the next month signals a supply shock, raising inflation expectations and prompting higher interest rates, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite the INDPRO falling below 98.7439.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in jobless claims (PAYEMS) over a quarter indicates strong labor market growth, but may overvalue labor markets, leading to eventual corrections and negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p < 0.05) in 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.15 in the next month signals a tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing growth expectations, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) below 13750.1 in the next month signals weak demand growth, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite GDPC1 falling below 13750.1.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDP (GDPC1) and the supply index (INDPRO) over the next month signals robust demand and supply growth, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 1000.0 and INDPRO rises > 98.7439 in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the simultaneous rise in GDPC1 and INDPRO.
